turns.content: My daughter just started secondary school this week. She was nervous but seems to have settled in okay.
The transition to secondary school is a big one. It's great she seems to be settling. How did the first week go?
Better than expected. She's come home tired but she's been chatty about her day which is a good sign.
Chatting about the day is always reassuring — a sign she's processing it positively. Has she made any friends yet?
She's got a few from primary who are at the same school. And she's already mentioned a couple of new names.
Going in with existing friends is such a help. The extracurriculars often do the work of building new friendships quickly.
She's thinking about joining the drama club. She's always loved performing but was too shy to do it at primary.
Secondary school drama clubs are often where kids find their people. Encouraging that.
